subject: Vendor onboarding: tax ID verification and evidence pathway (Atlas Health)

Subject: Next steps to complete vendor setup — tax docs & EIN confirmation

Hi Ben,

Thanks for starting the vendor setup. To clear the PO hold and move to active invoicing we need a completed tax form and one piece of supporting evidence for EIN confirmation. Specifically we accept:

- Completed W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN-E (for foreign entities)
- One of: bank account verification letter, Articles of Incorporation, or an IRS 147C

Can you please:
1) Return a signed W-9 (PDF) with the EIN visible exactly as it appears on your IRS docs
2) Attach one supporting document listed above that matches the legal name on the W-9

Attach files to this thread or upload to the DocuSign link I’ll send if you prefer. Once we have those items, finance will validate and release the PO.

Timelines: if we get docs back today we can target PO activation by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference

Subject: EIN check — mismatch flagged in vendor registry

Quick note — I ran the submitted EIN (12-3456789) through our vendor verification tool and it returned a mismatch against the tax vendor registry we use (different legal name associated). Common causes: hyphenation differences, DBA vs legal entity, or a stale record.

Next steps I recommend we ask Ben for one of the supporting docs (bank letter, Articles, or IRS 147C) that ties the EIN to the legal name on the W-9. If we don’t get that, we should escalate to Finance for manual crosswalk (slower).

Putting PO on temporary hold until evidence is received — flagging for Marissa to approve hold.

-Monica
Monica Patel
